title: record page header: the highlight strip clips its last values at 1440 ("+1-555-0") and at 390 mixes a two-column grid with an indented list — values truncate with a tooltip or wrap, and the phone strip keeps one layout
body:
Filing gate ① (a product defect, measured on `main`), filed on the maintainer's word (chat, 2026-10-15, session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, seat account os-bill): the seat ran a functional audit of the HotCRM console on objectui `main` `720f6d4` (report, private to the maintainer: https://claude.ai/artifact/XPrn5eZMsQaKUgasMJEMmR, findings F4 and F11, figures 6 and 15), and the maintainer answered 「同意开卡，使用 pm-dispatch 创建卡片」. Quota note: the audit's cards exceed the filing gate's three-per-fire quota on that word, which approved the report's card list as a set.

Parent: #12444. The record-page sibling of #11684 (closed by PR #11719, which fixed the drawer's fixed-basis chips). Blocks nothing; nothing blocks it.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane's next dispatch (seat post #9800), one dev round in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (`HeaderHighlight.tsx`), size S.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T14:14Z): "record page header highlight fields strip truncates phone email value clipped key fields mobile layout" → 7, all closed: #12188 (a lookup title at phone width), #11684 (the drawer's chips truncating short values; fixed by PR #11719: chips share the row's free width), #7245, #6083, #2249 (the 2026-07 strip layout pass), #1034 (the 2026-03 phone layout), #1006. None is this card: #11684's fix is in place and this card measures what is left on the record page.

## What happens

1. Desktop (1440, HotCRM lead "Mira Costa"): the highlight strip under the title shows Status · Lead Score · Lead Source · Lead Owner · Email · Phone; Phone reads "+1-555-0" and Email reads "mira.costa@atlasconstruction" — the last two values are clipped at the cell's edge with no ellipsis and no title. The anchor itself is not truncated (its scroll width equals its client width); the cell clips it. The same at 1024 and in the dark theme and zh locale.
2. Phone (390, the same record): the first two highlights (Status, Lead Score) sit side by side in a two-column grid; the next four (Lead Source, Lead Owner, Email, Phone) become a single-column list with a left rule and an indent. Two layouts in one strip; the email is clipped at its end there too.

## Readings (objectui `origin/main` `720f6d4`, read 2026-10-15T14:15Z)

1. `packages/plugin-detail/src/HeaderHighlight.tsx` line 113: the row is `flex flex-wrap gap-y-4`; lines 237–262: each chip is `grow max-w-max` with a `basis-[16rem] min-w-[min(16rem,100%)]` (wide kinds) or `basis-[9rem] min-w-[min(9rem,100%)]` floor (#11684); line 358: the value is `block min-w-0 truncate text-sm font-semibold`. With six chips at the record page's content width (about 1088 px at 1440) the floors sum past the row, the last chip's `max-w-max` holds its content width while the row clips it, so the value is cut without the `truncate` ellipsis ever applying.
2. `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` line 1599 renders the strip from `schema.highlightFields`; the console builds that list in `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` lines 2833–2902 from `objectDef.highlightFields`.
3. The phone reading is the same component at 390: the first line of the wrap holds two chips, the rest wrap one per line with the chip's own left border, which reads as a different layout.

## What to build

1. A chip that does not fit its line truncates with an ellipsis and carries the full value in `title` (the `truncate` span gets a bounded width: the chip's `max-w` is its share of the row, not `max-content`); the last chip of a line is never clipped by the row. When the chips' floors exceed the row, the strip wraps to a second line before any value is cut.
2. Below `sm` the strip is one layout: either every chip is a full-width "label · value" row, or a two-column grid throughout; the per-chip left border goes where it no longer separates columns.
3. The existing #11684 behaviour (chips share free width, a short value renders whole) is kept.

## Acceptance

- `HeaderHighlight` tests: six chips in a 1088 px row render every value whole or with an ellipsis and a `title`, none clipped (`scrollWidth` ≤ `clientWidth` on each chip); the #11684 pins unchanged; at a 358 px row every chip has the same layout class.
- Browser reading by the landing seat at 1440 on the HotCRM lead above: Phone reads "+1-555-0117-1119" whole or ends in an ellipsis with the full number in its tooltip; at 390 the strip's six chips share one layout.
- `pnpm test` from the repo root green on the affected files; a changeset (patch) for `@object-ui/plugin-detail`.

## Out of scope

- Which fields are highlights (HotCRM's `highlightFields`); the record drawer's strip beyond what the shared component fixes; the page header's title chip (#7244).

Attribution: written by the domain:ui seat in session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP` (account os-bill) on the maintainer's words quoted above.
